# User research

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The study of the people who use a product: their needs, their contexts, and how they use a design. Nielsen Norman Group maps research methods on three dimensions: attitudinal or behavioral, qualitative or quantitative, and the context of product use. Generative research finds the needs and the contexts before the team designs. Evaluative research tests a design with the people who use it.

## References

- You test a design or a product with users. Read [Evaluative research](evaluative-research.md).
- You study the needs, the work, or the context of users. Read [Generative research](generative-research.md).
- You plan a study of users or customers. Read [Research planning](research-planning.md).
- You turn the notes of a study into findings. Read [Research synthesis](research-synthesis.md).
